en: Color-tinted postcard showing a large Romanesque-style cathedral with four tall corner towers and an arcade of arches along the façade. In front of the church is a circular lawn with a statue on a pedestal in the center and paths with benches around it. The caption at the top reads "Pécs. Székesegyház." The reverse side has printed Hungarian text indicating a correspondence card, handwritten message and address, a red Hungarian postage stamp, and postal marks.
